top.title: Can Lifyorli Aid Corcept's Long-Term Growth Prospects Beyond Korlym?
top.summary: Corcept Therapeutics reported Korlym sales of $373.5 million in H1 2026, up 6.2% year-over-year. The FDA approval of Lifyorli (relacorilant) in March 2026 generated $47.6 million in Q2 2026, marking the company's first quarter of commercial availability. The new drug aims to reduce CORT's dependence on Korlym. Relacorilant is also being studied in combination with other therapies for various cancers, with an FDA decision on the Cushing's syndrome indication expected by December 2026.

top.summary: Owl Labs has launched the Meeting Owl 5, a 360-degree 4K teleconferencing camera featuring a 20MP sensor, eight omnidirectional microphones with 18-foot pickup range, AI-powered audio, and single-cable connectivity via USB-C. top.title: Anthropic IPO, MANGOS ETFs and the Future of the AI Trade
top.summary: An ETF Spotlight podcast episode discusses the sustainability of the AI rally amid inflation concerns and market volatility. Key topics include Anthropic's upcoming IPO, MANGOS ETF exposure to major AI companies, cybersecurity implications of AI, and uranium/nuclear energy demand from data centers. The episode explores risks associated with derivatives-based ETF exposure to private companies and the evolving cybersecurity landscape.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Alphabet Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Alphabet Inc. alleging that the company made false and misleading statements regarding Gemini 3.5 Pro's performance. The complaint claims the AI model delivered disappointing training results, leading to significant launch delays, and that management's positive statements about the company's business and prospects lacked a reasonable basis. Investors who purchased Alphabet securities between May 19, 2026 and July 16, 2026 are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 1, 2026.

top.title: Here's Why Alphabet (GOOGL) is a Strong Growth Stock
top.summary: Zacks Premium offers investment research tools including the Zacks Rank and Style Scores to help investors identify high-performing stocks. how_to_use: The command list is ranked by OPPORTUNITY = genuine signal magnitude × edge remaining × leading-vs-lagging gap — NOT by how many desks agree (agreement is a lagging, consensus condition). 'emerging' = a leading desk firing ahead of a quiet crowd with most of the move still ahead (where the edge is); 'exhausted' = already run, fade-risk. catalysts = fresh dated special-situation events. Every dossier names what would change its read and its edge_remaining; track both.
disclaimer: Context only — five research desks fused into one read per name, never a trade instruction and never a position size.

signal_governor.disclaimer: De-escalation-only signal governor. A signal is demoted ONLY once its matured, overlap-robust track record proves it mis-firing; trust never exceeds 1.0 and never sizes a position. Absent ⇒ hub is ungoverned.

track_record.note: Measuring — accruing forward observations; the hub's edge is not yet statistically proven. Early numbers are provisional, context-only.

accrual_gaps.note: Expected dates are pandas business days — NYSE market holidays inside the window are counted as gaps, so this over-reports rather than under-reports.

track_record.disclaimer: An accountable scorecard of the hub's own claims — opportunity rank and lifecycle stage graded against realized SPY-relative forward returns. Until a signal matures and clears a Newey-West significance bar it is 'measuring', never trusted. Nothing here sizes a position.
